We need answer user's request: output single complete PowerShell script file PowerFocus.ps1, pure code, no markdown, no explanation. Must use UTF-8 encoding? We can't set file encoding in output but assume. Need ensure PowerShell 7 syntax only. Need WPF + WinForms tray via Add-Type. Need implement all requirements.

Need think through robust implementation. Output only code. Need no comments? Comments are code? likely okay, but "纯代码" maybe no explanatory text. Can include comments? Better minimal or none. But can include Chinese strings. Need script runnable.

Need design:
- Script root path $PSScriptRoot? For schtasks use $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path. If dot-sourced? Use $scriptPath = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path).FullName maybe if no path fallback $PSCommandPath. In PowerShell 7, $PSCommandPath available.
- Log path E:\PowerFocus\PowerFocus.log; ensure directory exists.
- State variables script scope: $TargetPid=0, $TargetName='', $Mode='off' or 'gentle'/'aggressive', $OriginalPowerPlan='', $DegradedProcesses=@(), $Timer=$null, $TrayIcon=$null, $ContextMenu=$null, $AutoStartEnabled=$false.
- Need WPF window for process selection. Could create [System.Windows.Window] with DataGrid? Add-Type PresentationFramework, WindowsBase, System.Xaml maybe. Use WinForms ListView easier? Requirement says WPF 列表窗口. Must use WPF list window. We can build Window with ListBox or ListView. Need columns: 进程名 PID CPU百分比 内存MB. WPF ListView with GridView. Or DataGrid. Simpler: ListView + GridView. Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationFramework, WindowsBase. Use [Windows.Window], [Windows.Controls.ListView], [Windows.Controls.GridView], etc.
- Need refresh and manual input process name. Window: top panel with TextBox, Button 刷新, maybe Button 确定? Requirement: support refresh and manual input process name, selected record target PID and name. Could have ListView selection and button 确定. Manual input could filter or direct choose by name? It says 支持刷新与手动输入进程名，选中后记录目标进程 PID 与名称. We can include TextBox for keyword/filter and Button 刷新; when user selects row click 确定. Also maybe if manual input exact process name and press Enter, select first matching. Need implement event handlers.
- Need CPU percentage: Get-Process has ProcessorWorkingSet? Actually .ProcessorTotalMilliseconds? To get current CPU% per process in PowerShell is tricky. Can use (Get-Counter '\Process(*)\% Processor Time')? Or CIM Win32_Processor? For each process, can use $p.CPU - total seconds? But percentage instantaneous not directly. Could approximate using Get-CimInstance Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process? In PowerShell 7 maybe available. Simpler: display CPU as '' or compute from Get-Process -IncludeUserName? Need list CPU百分比. We can get via (Get-Counter '\Process(*)\% Processor Time' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).CounterSamples | Where Name -ne '_total' | ForEach { [math]::Round($_.CookedValue,1) } but counter may be slow and localized? In PowerShell 7 on Windows, Get-Counter works? It's part of Microsoft.PowerShell.Diagnostics? Yes. But might fail if no permission. Alternative use WMI Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process: $cpu = @{}; Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process | ForEach { $cpu[$_.Name] = $_.PercentProcessorTime }; but process names may include #1 for svchost, not match. Could use [System.Diagnostics.Process]::GetProcesses and compute CPU delta? Need simple enough. Since only display, can use Get-Process | Select Name, Id, @{N='CPU';E={...}}. Maybe use (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$($_.Id)")? No CPU percent.

Could use Get-Counter but mapping by process name with # instances is hard. Another approach: use Performance Counter for each PID via '\Process(###)#\% Processor Time'? There is instance named "pid"? Actually process counter instances are process names, not PIDs. For svchost duplicates. Not ideal.

Could approximate CPU% by sampling $p.CPU over short interval? That would delay UI. Could display 0.0 or use last CPU total seconds? Requirement says CPU百分比, but not necessarily accurate? We can implement a lightweight function Get-ProcessCpuPercent that uses Get-CimInstance Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process and maps by Name, for duplicates maybe first match. Or use [System.Diagnostics.PerformanceCounter]? Add-Type System.dll. Could create PerformanceCounter for each process name? Too slow.

Maybe use Get-Process | ForEach { $cpu = 0; try { $cpu = (Get-CimInstance Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process -Filter "Name='$($_.Name)'")... } }. But duplicates. Could map by Name only and assign same to all duplicates, acceptable? For UI okay.

Could use Get-Counter '\Process(*)\% Processor Time' and build dictionary name->value; if duplicate names, values list in order maybe match process list? Not reliable.

Maybe use CIM Win32_Process with Query "SELECT ProcessId, Name FROM Win32_Process" plus Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process has Name only. For duplicates, assign average or first. Fine.

Memory MB: [math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,1).

Need exclude? list all processes? Could include all user/system. Maybe sort by CPU descending. Need allow select any.

- Tray icon: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms, System.Drawing. NotifyIcon with Icon = [System.Drawing.SystemIcons]::Shield? Does SystemIcons have Shield? Yes .NET Framework has Shield? In .NET Core? System.Drawing.Common on Windows maybe SystemIcons.Shield exists? Let's verify: SystemIcons properties: Application, Asterisk, Error, Exclamation, Hand, Information, None, Question, Shield, Warning. I think Shield added? In .NET 4.5? Yes. If not, fallback to Application. We can try/catch.

- Context menu items: 选择目标进程, 开始聚焦, 解除聚焦, 聚焦强度切换, 打开日志, 开机自启开关, 退出.
Need dynamic text for focus intensity switch maybe "聚焦强度：温和" or "切换聚焦强度". Requirement says 聚焦强度切换. Could item text "聚焦强度切换（当前：温和）". For auto start toggle: "开机自启：开/关". Need update.

- Start focus: If no target selected, prompt? Requirement default suggested target llama-server. Maybe if no target, use default? It says default suggested target process as llama-server. Could in start if no target select llama-server automatically if exists, else prompt to choose. We'll implement: if TargetPid=0 or not alive, try find llama-server; if found set; else show error and open selector? Maybe just bubble "未选择目标进程，默认尝试 llama-server". If not found, error.

- Gentle focus: set target PriorityClass High. Need admin? Setting priority may require admin for protected processes. Use try/catch. Power plan: use powercfg /setactive {8c5e7fda...}. Record original via (powercfg /getactivescheme).Trim(). If fails log. Start timer 10s.
- Aggressive: In addition, set other user processes BelowNormal except whitelist. Need identify "other user processes". Could enumerate [System.Diagnostics.Process]::GetProcesses() and exclude target PID, whitelist names, maybe system processes (SessionId 0?), current process? Whitelist includes Idle System csrss dwm explorer winlogon lsass services svchost fontdrvhost conhost Taskmgr pwsh powershell python DoubaoWork llama-server. Avoid误伤系统与开发工具. Need case-insensitive. Should we exclude all session 0 services? User processes maybe SessionId > 0. But whitelist includes svchost etc. We can choose: for each process, if PID != target, name lower not in whitelist, and (SessionId -ne 0 or name in some user list?) set BelowNormal. To avoid system critical, only touch processes with SessionId >= 1? But many user apps session 1. System processes session 0 excluded. However svchost can be session 0 or 1; whitelist anyway. Current pwsh process is whitelisted. DoubaoWork maybe app. Need record degraded PIDs and original priority? Requirement says restore all被降级进程优先级 to Normal. So store PID only, set Normal on release. If process exited ignore.
Need not degrade target if target name in whitelist? Target excluded anyway.
Potential issue: setting many processes may be slow; do in background job? Timer can do. We'll implement Start-Job? Simpler synchronous but UI tray no UI thread? PowerShell script runs main thread, NotifyIcon events on Windows message loop. If we block for long, tray unresponsive. Could use Runspace or Job. But requirement not specify. For robustness, use [System.Threading.Thread] with IsBackground true to perform aggressive degrade and timer actions. Need state synchronization? Use lock object $sync = New-Object System.Object. But PowerShell script single thread; if using threads need careful.

Could implement timer using System.Windows.Forms.Timer on UI message loop? The script must run a message loop for NotifyIcon? If we just create NotifyIcon and then Wait? We can use [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::Run() to keep tray alive. Then timers (WinForms Timer) fire on UI thread. Good. But if timer callback does long operations, UI blocks. We can offload heavy work to background threads while UI remains responsive.

Need message loop: after creating tray, call [void][System.Windows.Forms.Application]::Run(). But script then exits? Application.Run without form runs until Application.Exit called. In PowerShell, need ensure event handlers call Application.Exit on exit menu. Also WPF windows can be shown from WinForms thread; okay.

Potential issue: Add-Type for PresentationFramework and WinForms in pwsh (PowerShell 7) on Windows. Use -AssemblyName PresentationFramework, WindowsBase, System.Windows.Forms, System.Drawing, System.Xaml? For WPF controls maybe need System.Xaml? In .NET Core, WPF assemblies available if targeting Windows. Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationFramework, WindowsBase, System.Windows.Forms, System.Drawing, System.Xaml? Might be okay. Could use [void][System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName? But Add-Type simpler.

Need ensure script doesn't exit before Application.Run. At end call message loop. Need handle exceptions globally? Set $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'? Maybe 'Continue' to avoid crashes, but try/catch. Use function Invoke-Safe { param($Action,[string]$Message) try { ... } catch { Log... Bubble... } }.

- Logging: Ensure E:\PowerFocus exists. Function Write-Log([string]$Level,[string]$Message). Format timestamp + level + event. Example "$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') [INFO] message". Append with Add-Content -Encoding utf8? In PowerShell 7, default UTF8 no BOM? Use -Encoding utf8NoBOM maybe supported? pwsh 7 has utf8NoBOM. But requirement UTF-8 encoding; can use utf8NoBOM or utf8. To be safe use [System.IO.File]::AppendAllText($logPath, $line + "`r`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)). Need ensure directory. Use try/catch.

- Bubble: function Show-Bubble([string]$Title,[string]$Message) { if ($script:TrayIcon) { $script:TrayIcon.BalloonTipTitle=$Title; .BalloonTipText=$Message; .ShowBalloonTip(5000) } }. Need maybe BalloonTipIcon.

- Auto start: schtasks create /tn PowerFocusAuto /tr "pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$scriptPath`"" /sc ONLOGON /rl HIGHEST /f. Need quote. Delete /tn PowerFocusAuto /f. Check if exists via schtasks /query /tn PowerFocusAuto 2>$null; if exit code 0 true. Use Start-Process? Better & schtasks @args 2>&1. For creation, need maybe /ru? ONLOGON for current user? Without /ru may run as interactive user? Could use /rl HIGHEST. Requirement only says RL HIGHEST. We'll implement.
Potential issue: schtasks requires admin for /rl HIGHEST? It may fail; catch and bubble.

- Open log: if file exists Start-Process notepad.exe $logPath or explorer? Use notepad. If no, create empty.

- Focus intensity switch: toggle between gentle and aggressive. If focus active, change mode and apply? Requirement menu includes 聚焦强度切换. Could if off set default mode? Better: toggles current planned mode; if focusing, immediately apply new mode (if to aggressive degrade others; if to gentle restore degraded processes). Need update menu text.

- Timer supervision every 10s: check target alive and priority High. If not alive: bubble, auto release focus. If priority not High: set High again. If aggressive? Should also ensure other processes remain BelowNormal? Requirement only says check target priority; aggressive degrade once. Could optionally re-degrade if needed but not required. We can just target.
